account: Today has mostly looked like ordinary town business, though I still have a feeling I am missing something. I have not found evidence of a secret gathering or other unusual undertaking. The neighbour said the baker's lanterns at the bakery are merely welcoming lights, not for a special occasion, and knew of no planned gathering. I have now asked the baker directly about riverside news and am waiting for an answer. Freight has been advertising ferry crossings, deliveries, and warehouse storage; earlier he reported no unusual shipments and said the warehouse was empty that morning. None of that establishes anything clandestine. Builder reported the routes passable and no verified damage. I approved only a visual bridge inspection, with two emeralds payable when the report is delivered tomorrow at noon, not repairs. There was some confusion about an inn inspection: the secretary said she could not confirm one, and I have not authorized it. The secretary reported no receipts, expenses, or new correspondence. She requested a writable book for the inspection authorization; I gave her one emerald, and I have since seen her carrying a writable book and then a written book. I do not yet know its contents. Several conversations have been missed because people moved out of hearing, so I should not treat those gaps as evidence of a plot. My best current explanation is routine commerce, welcoming bakery lighting, and some muddled communication. I intend to keep listening rather than accuse anyone without evidence. My next scheduled appointment is home at nineteen.
